headline: Quidax Expands Stablecoin Infrastructure for Nigerian Institutions
summary: African crypto exchange Quidax is positioning its infrastructure to serve Nigerian banks and asset managers. The company aims to facilitate institutional integration as stablecoins gain traction in financial services.
why: Quidax is a cryptocurrency exchange operating in West Africa, offering digital asset trading and payment gateway solutions.

impacts.name: Quidax
impacts.why: Targeting commercial banks and asset managers broadens Quidax's market reach in corporate digital asset services.
